mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_REVIEW.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO REVIEW ( REVIEW_ID, DEAL_ID, WRITER_ID, TARGET_ID, RATING, CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{dealId}, -- = roomId #{writerId}, #{targetId}, #{rating}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, DEAL_ID AS dealId, WRITER_ID AS writerId, TARGET_ID AS targetId, RATING AS rating, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REVIEW WHERE DEAL_ID = #{dealId} AND WRITER_ID = #{writerId}

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, r.DEAL_ID AS dealId, r.WRITER_ID AS writerId, r.TARGET_ID AS targetId, r.RATING AS rating, r.CONTENT AS content, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt,
u.NAME AS writerName, -- 작성자 이름 p.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, -- 상품 ID p.TITLE AS productTitle, -- 상품명 p.IMAGE_PATH AS productImagePath, -- 상품 이미지 경로
CASE WHEN c.BUYER_ID = r.WRITER_ID THEN 'BUYER' WHEN c.SELLER_ID = r.WRITER_ID THEN 'SELLER' ELSE NULL END AS writerRole
FROM REVIEW r JOIN CHAT_ROOM c ON r.DEAL_ID = c.ROOM_ID -- ★ roomId 기준 조인 JOIN PRODUCT p ON c.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID JOIN MOKU_USER u ON r.WRITER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE r.TARGET_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, r.DEAL_ID AS dealId, r.WRITER_ID AS writerId, r.TARGET_ID AS targetId, r.RATING AS rating, r.CONTENT AS content, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt,
t.NAME AS targetName, -- 상대방 이름 p.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.TITLE AS productTitle, p.IMAGE_PATH AS productImagePath,
CASE WHEN c.BUYER_ID = r.WRITER_ID THEN 'BUYER' WHEN c.SELLER_ID = r.WRITER_ID THEN 'SELLER' ELSE NULL END AS writerRole
FROM REVIEW r JOIN CHAT_ROOM c ON r.DEAL_ID = c.ROOM_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON c.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID JOIN MOKU_USER t ON r.TARGET_ID = t.USER_ID WHERE r.WRITER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC
